p: build the house: That is, govern and dispose all things pertaining to the family.
city: The public estate of the commonwealth.
you to rise up early: Who watch and ward and are also magistrates and rulers of the city.
of sorrows: Either that which is gained by hard labour, or eaten with grief of mind.
sleep: Not exempting them from labour, but making their labours comfortable and as it were a rest.
children of the youth: That is, endued with strength and virtues from God: for these are signs of God's blessings, and not the number.
shall not be ashamed: Such children will be able to stop their adversaries mouths, when their godly life is maliciously accused before judges.
